description: Figure 4 displays a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrating the mean absolute values of hidden states across layers before and after gating, with a baseline for comparison. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 in integer increments, representing the depth of the network layers. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is scaled linearly from 0 to 4, indicating the absolute mean value of the hidden states. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," which starts near 0.1, rises gradually to approximately 0.6 by layer 10, and then increases sharply to nearly 4 by layer 20; an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," which remains consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which stays nearly flat at approximately 0.04 throughout the entire range. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the near-constant low values of the orange and green lines.
